statement.p: Compute the curl of the vector field \vec{F} = \left(x+y\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+\left(z-y\right)\,\mathit{\vec j}+\left(z+x\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}

solution.me: \mbox{curl}\vec{F} = \left| \begin{array}{ccc} \quad\vec i\quad \amp \quad\vec j\quad \amp \quad\vec k\quad \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial y} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial z}\\ \quad x+y\quad \amp \quad z-y\quad \amp \quad z+x\quad \end{array} \right| = -\,\mathit{\vec i}-\,\mathit{\vec j}-\,\mathit{\vec k}.
